decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system builds directly on the firm's office furniture expertise, so management can read its early results and refine it through in-house development.
The chair family sits at the core of the firm's craftsmanship and design knowledge, which makes it easy to assimilate feedback and keep improving the line.
Floor cushions made from carpets extend the firm's material expertise and upholstery skills, though as a niche accessory line it carries some risk of being trimmed.
The soft upholstered sofa fits the firm's established upholstery know-how, although it is only mentioned on the website rather than given its own page, which suggests lower prominence.
The high standing table closely matches existing office and conference tables, so the firm can apply its prior knowledge to it at low cost.
The rug collection is distant from the firm's core knowledge, which limits absorptive capacity, but its flagship status and the firm's designer collaboration support keeping it while the firm learns.
